items.question: Furosemide acts on which part of the nephron?
items.explanation: Furosemide inhibits the Na-K-2Cl cotransporter in the thick ascending limb, a powerful loop diuretic.

items.question: Vigabatrin acts by?
items.explanation: Vigabatrin irreversibly inhibits GABA transaminase, raising brain GABA; risk of visual field defects.

items.question: Which gout drug is a selective xanthine oxidase inhibitor and non-purine?
items.explanation: Febuxostat is a non-purine selective xanthine oxidase inhibitor for chronic gout; useful if allopurinol is not tolerated.

items.question: Which electrolyte disturbance increases digoxin toxicity?
items.explanation: Hypokalemia increases digoxin binding to Na-K ATPase, precipitating toxicity. Watch in patients on diuretics.

items.question: Which test compares means of two independent groups with normal data?

*PharmaCraft Daily - 26 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Renal)
Q: Furosemide acts on which part of the nephron?
Ans: Thick ascending loop of Henle
Why: Furosemide inhibits the Na-K-2Cl cotransporter in the thick ascending limb, a powerful loop diuretic.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Central Nervous System)
Q: Vigabatrin acts by?
Ans: Inhibiting GABA transaminase
Why: Vigabatrin irreversibly inhibits GABA transaminase, raising brain GABA; risk of visual field defects.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Autacoids and NSAIDs)
Q: Which gout drug is a selective xanthine oxidase inhibitor and non-purine?
Ans: Febuxostat
Why: Febuxostat is a non-purine selective xanthine oxidase inhibitor for chronic gout; useful if allopurinol is not tolerated.

🌍 *FMGE* (Cardiovascular)
Q: Which electrolyte disturbance increases digoxin toxicity?
Ans: Hypokalemia
Why: Hypokalemia increases digoxin binding to Na-K ATPase, precipitating toxicity. Watch in patients on diuretics.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Biostatistics)
Q: Which test compares means of two independent groups with normal data?
Ans: Student t-test
Why: The unpaired Student t-test compares means of two independent, normally distributed groups. ANOVA compares three or more.
